source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of keyword arguments (PDF 47).

blocks.text: Function ko keyword arguments se bhi bulaya ja sakta hai, yani har value ke saath parameter ka naam likh kar. Is se code parhna aasan hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ka code aise nahi chalta: return indented nahi, aur “years old." aur “Ali" tirchhi (curly) quote se shuru hote hain (SyntaxError). Yeh theek kar bhi dein to strings mein spaces nahi, is liye output "My name is  Aliand I am20years old." aata hai. Oopar spaces wala sahi code hai, jo "My name is Ali and I am 20 years old." deta hai.
Wazahat: introduce ko keyword arguments se bulaya gaya: pehle age=20, phir name="Ali". Order (tarteeb) ulta hai magar Python har value ko us ke naam wale parameter se milati hai.

blocks.prompt: Call kyun chalti hai halanke age name se pehle diya gaya?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke har argument parameter ke naam se milaya jata hai, position (jagah) se nahi.

items: Keyword argument: naam=value; order se farq nahi parta.
